purpose: Supervisor progress demonstration; test whether timestamped news adds information beyond finance and news coverage.
purge_rule: All target outcomes must occur strictly before the next segment starts.
news_timing: First NYSE close at or after max(source publication, archive download, modification). Date-only publications delayed by one UTC day.
calibration: One fixed sigmoid fit on the separate 2022 segment; no method search.
paired_comparison: Full sentiment arm versus coverage-only arm on identical 2023 ticker/session rows.
selection_rule: Do not replace the live model using this exploratory pilot.
limitations: 2023 has already been examined elsewhere in QuantSight; this is not an untouched final test.
Existing finance feature selection was influenced by historical results.
The fixed ticker universe is not point-in-time index membership.
Archive timestamps are conservative proxies and article versions require further validation.
VADER is a transparent first baseline, not evidence about FinBERT or all sentiment methods.
Classification results are not trading returns or Sharpe ratios.
